content.text:
I can't get a live reading, and the sources I found disagree with each other. Their numbers range from about 11 to 33 minutes for standard lanes, and most of the snapshots are months old.

- **Most recent snapshot:** One tracker showed about 11 minutes for the whole airport, but the page dates its data to July 11, 2026, so it's stale. [qsensor](https://qsensor.co/airports/new-york-john-f-kennedy-international-airport-tsa-wait-times/)
- **Other trackers:** One says standard security at JFK currently averages about 22 minutes, with PreCheck under 11 minutes. [flightqueue](https://flightqueue.com/john-f-kennedy-international-airport-security-wait-times) Another lists 33 minutes for general lanes and 17 for PreCheck, with Terminal 4 the slowest at 45 minutes. [terminaltracker](https://terminaltracker.co/airport/JFK/) A third gives about 28 minutes for standard and 10 for PreCheck, but labels that figure a historical average. [tsalinecheck](https://tsalinecheck.com/airport/JFK)
- **Typical patterns:** Waits tend to peak around 5–8 AM and 3–7 PM. [takeofftimer](https://www.takeofftimer.com/airports/JFK)

For a real-time figure, check one of the live trackers above, which refresh roughly every five minutes, or contact JFK directly by phone or social media. [johnfkennedyairport-jfk](https://johnfkennedyairport-jfk.com/wait-times/) Plan for about 25–35 minutes in standard lanes, and more during the peak windows.
